title: Jack Carey's style
summary: Allen asks about Jack Carey. Ridgley says he had a very good ear, could pop high notes and was a good hummer.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: I wanted to ask you about the Jack Carey style so he could get an idea of what Jack Carey played like.

Jack was a good, you know, a good, he had a very good ear. He was speaking about that fast tone and all like that, Jack could do that and he was good, he could pop them notes high up there too and he was a good hummer, that means he called a singer on the trumpet. Well that was most of our style then, you know. The singer is the gliss or the slide? Yeah, like that. Now a tiger egg.
